## p118 A2 — Separately received second part of Mackensen withdrawal report

**Edition context:** Mackensen's withdrawal report: the separately received second part.

<a id="edition-cases-military-mackensen-withdrawal-part2-mackensens-withdrawal-report-the-separately-received-second-part"></a>



**Source edition and verification: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.**

Printed p118 explicitly identifies this record as the **second part of the
thirteen-part message sent at 20:00 on 11/3**. It supplies the source witness
missing from the earlier [twelve-part repository edition](113.md#edition-cases-military-mackensen-withdrawal-report).
The header, source number and unchanged Nov1–3 key bind the second part to
that report; no historical English translation is back-translated into
cipher evidence.

The source has 377 valid coordinates against `RICHI-378`. Its eighth ciphertext
row begins with the visibly short four-glyph group **FGAD**. The conditional
378-coordinate frame below inserts one unknown coordinate inside that group,
then separately prices its fill and every observed-coordinate change.

<a id="source-p118-a2"></a>
<a id="edition-cases-military-mackensen-withdrawal-part2-p118-a2"></a>

### p118 A2

The page heading gives 3 November, reception is 6 November, and the explicit
assembly note gives 20:00 on 11/3. These source date layers remain separate.

```text
3rd NOVEMBER, 1918.
A) LP v UKS (04.06 a.m., November 6th)
(Following is 2nd TLE of 13 TLE message sent at 20:00 11/3)
2 TL RICHI-378
```

Observed coordinate changes, with zero-based source indices: **6 F→V**, **45 F→V**, **47 D→F**, **48 F→D**, **49 G→F**, **62 F→V**, **112 F→D**, **114 A→G**, **138 G→V**, **164 X→V**, **215 G→F**, **225 V→A**, **229 G→F**.

The modeled slot at source boundary 283 is filled **V**, reconstructing
`FGAD` as `FGAVD`. It has no source index and is not counted as a printed-mask
fill. All 377 observed source positions remain in order; no observed position is deleted. The complete
edited stream re-encrypts exactly to this declared frame and these changes.

**Readable German — complete baseline edited stream, with spacing and punctuation only:**

> Seit 1 / 11 / 18 ergibt sich jedoch das Bild, dass die serbischen Armeen mit 3 franz. Div. im Vormarsch gegen Belgrad, SHMENDRIA begriffen sind und der bei VID8N und OO2PALANKA beabsichtigte Angriff aufgegeben zu sein scheint.

**Meaning:** For the period beginning 1/11/18, the report assesses that the Serbian armies with 3 French divisions are advancing toward Belgrade and the literal place label SHMENDRIA; the attack planned near the literal labels VID8N and OO2PALANKA appears to have been abandoned. This is the report's assessment, not independent evidence of the actual movements.

<a id="edition-cases-military-mackensen-withdrawal-part2-the-source-geometry-supports-the-selected-local-frame"></a>

### The source geometry supports the selected local frame

All 378 possible single-insertion boundaries were tested against the exact
baseline template. Boundary 283 is the unique minimum at 13 observed
substitutions plus one missing-coordinate fill. The five possible boundaries
in or immediately after the four-letter group give:

| Source boundary | Missing coordinate supplied | Observed substitutions |
| ---: | :---: | ---: |
|280|F|16|
|281|G|15|
|282|A|14|
|283|V|13|
|284|D|14|

This is a bounded comparison under a fixed proposed reading and unchanged
published key. It does not prove that no different historical damage model
could explain the record. The original 377-coordinate odd frame, its raw
pair decoding and the final orphan coordinate are also retained in the
certificate; the orphan is never silently discarded from the source.

<a id="edition-cases-military-mackensen-withdrawal-part2-place-labels-and-numerical-labels"></a>

### Place labels and numerical labels

The baseline deliberately retains the source-derived names **SHMENDRIA**,
**VID8N** and **OO2PALANKA**. Their familiar geographical interpretations are
kept out of the baseline coordinate count.

**Conditional interpretation — optional geographical spellings:**

Changing those three labels to **SEMENDRIA**, **VIDIN** and **LOMPALANKA**
costs four additional observed-coordinate substitutions:

| Source index | Observed change |
| ---: | :---: |
|113|G→F|
|228|F→G|
|271|G→A|
|371|F→V|

That optional complete stream has 17 observed substitutions and the same
one-coordinate insertion/fill. Its re-encryption is certified separately;
these plausible names are not independent geographical identifications.

The baseline keeps the exact date labels **1/11/18** and count **3**. Changes
from 0 to R in `VORMARSCH` and from 7 to G in `GEGEN` and `AUFGEGEBEN` are
ordinary-word proposals with explicit coordinate costs. The raw forms are
shown above, so no numeral reassignment is hidden in the readable layer.

<a id="edition-cases-military-mackensen-withdrawal-part2-attribution-and-evidence"></a>

### Attribution and evidence

Historical decipherment of the withdrawal report belongs to **J. Rives
Childs**. **George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker** published
a reconstruction in 2016; the earlier repository edition records that
attribution and the published-key credit. An unreviewed merged OCR screen
already suggested much of this second part. The present contribution is
its primary-source review, exact short-group geometry, exhaustive local
insertion pricing and complete qualified reading. No first-decipherment
priority is claimed.
